insight: A Y Combinator (S23) startup that raised a $40M Series B led by Emergence Capital in 2024, reaching $65M total funding.
name: Bland AI
tagline: Enterprise voice AI platform for automated phone calls.
description: An enterprise platform for building AI agents that handle inbound and outbound phone calls 24/7 with natural, real-time conversation. Bland bundles the language model, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and telephony into a single per-minute rate, and integrates with tools like Twilio, Salesforce, HubSpot, and Zapier. Build agents in a web dashboard or via a REST API; a free tier lets you start before moving to usage-based paid tiers.

modelSupport.notes: Bundles its voice stack into one rate; the underlying LLM is configurable on the platform.

edge: Bundles LLM, STT, TTS and telephony into one all-inclusive per-minute rate — the simplest stack to deploy.
pros: Fast non-technical setup in a single dashboard
cons: Voice quality a tier below Retell/tuned Vapi
Less customization, conversation logic locked in
